messages.ko: 하이! 오늘 이렇게 밴쿠버까지 무대를 함으로서 이번 투어 공연은 끝이났네ㅔ..
messages.en: Hi! Today, by performing all the way here in Vancouver, this tour's concerts have come to an end..
It kind of feels like I finished it safely~ but at the same time, I feel a little sad that it's over.

messages.ko: 익숙하면서도 새로운 미국,캐나다 웨이브의 에너지로 또 다시 힘을 얻고가는것같아서 너무 고마워ㅠㅠ
messages.en: The energy from the WAVs in the U.S. and Canada felt both familiar and new, and I feel like I'm leaving with renewed strength. Thank you so much. ㅠㅠ
Now I'll go back to Korea and work hard again!!
I've been to so many countries thanks to tripleS,

messages.ko: 그 많은 나라에 우리를 좋아해주는 사람들이 이렇게 많구나
messages.en: and every time I'm amazed that there are so many people in all those countries who love us.
It always touches me, and it makes me want to do even better.
I feel like I've found my determination again.

messages.ko: 저번에 말했지만 나를,우리를 좋아해줘서 너무너무 고마워ㅜㅜ
messages.en: Like I said before, thank you so, so much for loving me and loving us. ㅜㅜ

messages.ko: 난 앞으로 웨이브한테 우주최고의 실력을 보여주고싶어
messages.en: From now on, I want to show WAVs the best performance and skills in the universe.

messages.ko: 큰 욕심이지만 웨이브가 옆에있으면 해낼수 있을것같아
messages.en: It's a huge goal, but I think I can achieve it if WAVs are by my side.

messages.ko: 그래서 내가 할수있는데까진 정말 잘하려고 노력할거야
messages.en: So I'll truly do my best, as much as I'm capable of.
Please keep watching me!

messages.ko: 내가 항상 지켜봐달라 응원해달라 하는말에 진심으로 응원해주려고 노력하는게 보여서 그것도 너무 고마워 ㅠㅠ
messages.en: Whenever I ask you to keep watching me and cheer for me, I can see how sincerely you try to support me. I'm so thankful for that too. ㅠㅠ
As much as I receive,
I want to give it back.
If you're ever having a hard time or feeling exhausted,
Tell me first.
Who made things hard for you!!!
Do they want to taste my fiery fist?
Like that.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Anyway!

messages.ko: 하연이는 실력이 안 늘고 더 잘하고 싶은데 안될 때 마인드라든지 어떤 생각을 해? 노래를 하는데 요즘 정말 실력이 느는 느낌이 안들어서 많이 힘들고 생각이 많아져..
messages.en: Hayeon, when your skills don't seem to improve even though you want to get better, what kind of mindset do you have? Lately, when I sing, I don't feel like I'm improving at all, so it's been really hard and I've been overthinking a lot.
Hmm.
For me...
I just let myself struggle.
It's not like I have some special solution.
I think about it deeply and let myself feel that hardship.
But after some time...
It's somehow resolved as if it was never a problem.
Later I end up saying, 'Wow, I struggled so much back then~'
And I just move on.

messages.ko: 힘들 때 굳이 힘들지 않으려고 할 필요는 없는 것 같아
messages.en: I don't think you need to force yourself not to feel hurt when things are difficult.
That's right.
Eat something you like.
Eat malatang.
When I get back to Korea...
Before I even arrive at the dorm from the airport,
I'm going to order it right away,
and as soon as I walk in...
I'm going to eat it.
What ingredient are you going to load it up with the most?
Potatoes.
Potatoes are delicious.
Potatoes... in malatang...?
What's with those dots? You're hurting the potatoes' feelings.
How spicy do you get it?
Level 1.
No, but after coming here...
I've become even worse at handling spicy food.
Last time I ate Sesame Ramyeon...
It was so spicy that I couldn't finish it...
Can you believe it?
There was just something...
About the spiciness...
That really got me.
And today...
After the performance...

messages.ko: 두바이 초콜릿 타르트같은거 먹어서 기분 조음
messages.en: I ate something like a Dubai chocolate tart, so I'm in a good mood.
Y/n, hehehehe.
Jealous, right?
Now I'm going to go wash up.
I always love you~~
Haranghae 😘
